messages:
Sam West: hey team — Sam here, joining Monday as a backend engineer. Quick security/onboarding questions: when is the mandatory security training scheduled? I also need a YubiKey and an encrypted dev laptop — is there a hardware queue? I'm on the US East coast. Anything I should do before Day 1? thanks!

Alex P (People Ops): welcome Sam! 🎉 Training is in the LMS: https://lms.redwood.example/courses/security-basics — please complete the 'Security Basics' module within 72h of your start. We also run a live ~30m security intro every Tue at 10am PT (optional).

Jamie (Security): hey @Sam West — +1 on the 72h. Phish-sim enrollment happens automatically ~2 weeks after your start date; opt-out is only for approved accessibility or contractual reasons. If you need accommodations, DM me and we'll record that before sims start.

Jen (IT): @Sam West for YubiKey + laptop, fill the hardware request form: https://intra.redwood/tools/hardware-request — we batch orders Mon/Thu. If you need expedited shipping reply here and I can bump the queue. For MDM enrollment (Mac) run:
```
sudo profiles install -type configuration -path /path/to/profile.mobileconfig
sudo /usr/bin/fdesetup enable -user $USER
```
Send a screenshot of the MDM status page if anything errors. For Windows devices follow the Autopilot instructions linked from that form.

onboard-bot: ticket #HW-12987 created for Sam West (YubiKey + Dev laptop). Current ETA: 3-5 business days.

Tara (Eng Manager): hi Sam — if provisioning stalls, ping me and I can arrange a temporary loaner so you can start work Day 1. Also let me know if you prefer a Linux image.

Sam West: thanks all — filled the hardware form and started the LMS module. Couple follow-ups: do I need to enable 2FA on personal accounts (GitHub/Slack) now, or after I get the SSO invite? Also, who do I contact if FileVault setup prompts hang?

Alex P (People Ops): enable 2FA on any accounts you'll use for Redwood access before requesting org access. We support WebAuthn (YubiKey) for GitHub; once you have the SSO invite, link your key then.

Jamie (Security): also generate backup codes and store them in a password manager. If you have any questions about password managers or secrets handling, ping me or check our secrets policy: https://intra.redwood/policies/secrets.

Jen (IT): if FileVault setup hangs, take a photo of the error and drop it here or DM me. If you're comfortable, run:
```
pm run get-mdm-status # internal helper (mac only)
cat /var/log/install.log | tail -n 50
```
and attach output. We'll triage quickly.

Sam West: great — appreciate the fast help! :thumbsup: I’ll upload the screenshots if anything pops. Looking forward to joining.
